failedObjCount.description: Number of objs that encountered errors during processing.

skippedObjCount.description: Number of objs that being skipped during processing.

dbWait.description: If supported by the operation, the amount of time (in msec) that was spent waiting for the execution of database requests.

time.description: Total amount of time (in sec) that the operation took.

dbTime.description: Total amount of time (in sec) spent in db operations (both relational and KV).

totalTransformationTime.description: The total amount of Transformation time spent in secs

successfulObjCount.description: Count of canonical objects successfully processed

rejectedObjCount.description: Count of canonical objects rejected to import, excludes failedObjCount

targetTypeStats.description: Stores stats for each of the targettypes being imported as part of canonical import
